digest.component_or_area: live DC harness integration tests / bridge reconciler output contract
propositions: Commit c87afedba8 re-pointed DC harness cells to the sync route, which deliberately suppresses OK: stdout summary per __main__.py:437 gate and documented contract.
Two live test assertions in test_reconcile_pass.py still assert on OK: line output that the sync route never emits, causing false failures in run 31362329118.
The sync route emits BRIDGE_STATE: converged on stderr and RECON telemetry (differ totals, batch_outcome per-mutation lines) but no OK: summary, making those signals the correct contract basis.
Zero-write idempotence assertion requires BRIDGE_STATE: converged plus both RECON differ totals zero plus zero batch_outcome lines, because CONVERGED is emitted even when mutations apply.
Test helpers and their assertions must be decoupled from __main__.py line numbers and made unit-testable via a pure parsing module independent of reconciler code.
